title: German Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired chicken stew with tender chicken and vegetables. Serve with a side of crusty bread or over egg noodles.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from pot and set aside.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, whisking constantly.
Return chicken to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
